title: Explore with Memory, Learn without It: In-Context Exploration and Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.17734v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Exploration bounds learning efficiency in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Current methods explore mostly through independent sampling, without fully using the information gathered along the way, such as known wrong answers and environment feedback. We propose LEAF, which injects a dynamic, problem-specific memory into the context before every rollout. The memory contains the most recent response, its reward, and other environment feedback. It is updated after every verifier call. We decouple policy updates from rollouts and update the policy through self-distillation. On four benchmarks and two open models, LEAF accelerates exploration by about 4x compared with a random sampling baseline. On unseen test sets, it improves accuracy over the strongest baseline by 1.59 and 1.83 percentage points on the two models, while using less compute than any RL baseline. translated_title: 带着记忆探索，不带记忆学习：面向大语言模型推理的上下文内探索与自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 探索限制了可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的学习效率。当前的方法主要通过独立采样进行探索，未能充分利用探索过程中收集到的信息，例如已知的错误答案和环境反馈。我们提出了LEAF，它在每次rollout之前向上下文中注入动态的、针对特定问题的记忆。该记忆包含最近的响应、其对应的奖励以及其他环境反馈，并在每次验证器调用后进行更新。我们将策略更新与rollout解耦，并通过自蒸馏来更新策略。在四个基准测试和两个开源模型上，与随机采样基线相比，LEAF将探索速度提升约4倍。在未见过的测试集上，它在两个模型上的准确率分别比最强基线提高了1.59和1.83个百分点，同时计算开销低于任何RL基线。这些结果凸显了LEAF在改进……
tldr: LEAF方法通过在上下文中注入包含最新响应与反馈的动态问题记忆来加速RLVR探索，并将策略更新与rollout解耦、通过自蒸馏进行学习，从而以更少的计算量显著提升大语言模型推理的准确率。
en_tdlr: LEAF accelerates exploration in RLVR by injecting a dynamic problem-specific memory into the context before each rollout and updating the policy via self-distillation, improving LLM reasoning accuracy over the strongest baselines while using less compute.
